sentences.en: The protege of the coalition, Alexander Balas, married Philometor's daughter Cleopatra (Thea), and reigned in Syria in practical subservience to him.

sentences.en: We collaborated with Anna Dabrowski in Berlin and Thea Mehl in Oslo, who designed our two, solid-colored, felt coaster collections.
